### Standards & Smells Review: [ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L1-L67)

#### (a) Documented Standards & Rust Idiom Violations

1. **Missing Domain Types & API Contract (Hard Violation — [CONTEXT.md](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/CONTEXT.md#L16-L19), [ADR 0002](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/docs/adr/0002-decoupled-generic-ai-client.md#L10-L18))**
   - [ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L14-L48) defines only a private function `async fn text(system: &str, user: &str)` instead of the specified `AiClient`, `CompletionRequest`, `ChatMessage` types, and dual-mode completion methods (`complete(prompt, system)` and `complete_json_array(prompt, system)` with heuristic markdown code-fence stripping).

2. **Hardcoded Endpoint, Model & Env Loading Instead of Configurable Client (Hard Violation — [ADR 0002 §4](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/docs/adr/0002-decoupled-generic-ai-client.md#L17))**
   - [ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L15-L25) loads `.env` (`dotenv().ok()`), reads `OPENAI_API_KEY` from the process environment, and hardcodes `with_api_base("https://ry953ga.abc-tunnel.us/v1")` and `.model("free")`. ADR 0002 requires `AiClient` to accept arbitrary `base_url`, `api_key`, and `model` configurations.

3. **Panicking on Missing Configuration inside a `Result`-Returning Function (Hard Violation — Rust Error-Handling Idiom)**
   - [ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L16): `env::var("OPENAI_API_KEY").expect("API Key not found")` panics instead of propagating the error via `?` in a function returning `Result<String, Box<dyn Error>>`.

4. **Non-`Send + Sync` Error Type Across Async Boundaries (Judgement Call / Rust Async Idiom)**
   - [ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L14): Returning `Box<dyn Error>` (without `+ Send + Sync`) prevents callers from spawning `text()` onto multi-threaded Tokio tasks (`tokio::spawn`), conflicting with background job requirements in [CONTEXT.md](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/CONTEXT.md#L33).

5. **Unnecessary Intermediate `Result` Wrapping (Judgement Call — Rust Idiom)**
   - [ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L40-L47): Binds `let llm_response = ... .ok_or("Empty response");` followed by `Ok(llm_response?)` instead of directly returning `response.choices.into_iter().next().and_then(|c| c.message.content).ok_or_else(|| "Empty response".into())`.

6. **Live External Network Call in Unit Test (Hard Violation — [ADR 0002 Consequences](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/docs/adr/0002-decoupled-generic-ai-client.md#L22))**
   - [ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L54-L65): `test_text` hits a live tunnel URL and requires `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the environment instead of testing headlessly with mock HTTP servers or test strings.

---

#### (b) Baseline Code Smells (Judgement Calls)

1. **Mysterious Name** ([ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L14))
   > `async fn text(system: &str, user: &str) -> Result<String, Box<dyn Error>>`
   - `text` is a noun that does not convey performing an async chat completion request (ADR 0002 specifies `complete`), and its `system`/`user` parameters are ignored in favor of hardcoded strings ([ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L29-L33)).

2. **Primitive Obsession** ([ai.rs](file:///home/derek/projects/ryz/src/core/ai.rs#L14))
   > `async fn text(system: &str, user: &str) -> Result<String, Box<dyn Error>>`
   - Raw `&str` pairs and ad-hoc locals stand in for the domain concepts `AiClient`, `CompletionRequest`, and `ChatMessage` defined in `CONTEXT.md`.
